entries.title: Use Asset, Asset Bank, Condition, and Overlay terminology
entries.summary: Retire Active Effects/Pending Effects as current terminology. Persistent banked cards are Assets in the Asset Bank; temporary ongoing cards are Conditions; Territory-attached cards may be Overlays.

entries.title: Player-facing framing emphasizes running the Gauntlet
entries.summary: Heartland/end-space language is subordinate to the core fantasy of advancing through and running the Gauntlet.

entries.title: Earlier Arcane faction naming is superseded by Mystics
entries.summary: The exported discussions settled on Arcane as the faction name at that time. The later repository decision renamed the faction Mystics while retaining Arcane as a cross-faction trait.
